title: @sim
description: a world under @sim: a graph document, Prolog rules and a tuple space's seed and strategy, each optional; a key left out makes its workspace empty

graph.description: the graph document @graph takes: nodes by id and edges by source and target, or a bare map of nodes

rules.description: Prolog clauses for the rules workspace: one text, or a list of texts

events.description: the tuple space as @tspace takes it: a seed of tuples, a strategy, and at most one backing
